name: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
trans: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

name: The Spring Festival usually falls in January or February.
During the Spring Festival, family members get together and have a big dinner.
trans: 春节期间，家人团聚并吃年夜饭。

name: People hang red lanterns and put up couplets to create a festive atmosphere.
trans: 人们挂红灯笼、贴春联，营造节日气氛。

name: Children receive red envelopes from their parents and relatives.
trans: 孩子们从父母和亲戚那里收到红包。

name: The Lantern Festival is celebrated on the 15th day of the first lunar month.
trans: 元宵节在农历正月十五庆祝。

name: People eat yuanxiao and enjoy lantern displays during the Lantern Festival.
trans: 元宵节人们吃元宵、赏花灯。

name: Qingming Festival is a time for people to pay respect to their ancestors.
trans: 清明节是人们祭拜祖先的日子。

name: The Dragon Boat Festival is celebrated in memory of the ancient poet Qu Yuan.
trans: 端午节是为了纪念古代诗人屈原。

name: People watch dragon boat races and eat zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival.
trans: 端午节人们看龙舟赛、吃粽子。

name: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion.
trans: 中秋节是家庭团聚的时刻。

name: People eat mooncakes and enjoy the full moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
trans: 中秋节人们吃月饼、赏月。

name: National Day is a public holiday in China.
trans: 国庆节是中国的公共假日。

name: Festivals play an important role in passing down traditional culture.
trans: 节日在传承传统文化方面发挥重要作用。

name: We should celebrate festivals in a safe and environmentally friendly way.
trans: 我们应以安全、环保的方式庆祝节日。
